description: Canonical Architecture Assistant BUILD_PLAN - the human-readable, editable plan document that lives with the project. Small-step migration from the current software-oriented Architecture Assistant toward a universal category-driven project architecture, research, simulation and execution supervisor. This file is the source of truth for the plan; .worker_tandem/tandem_state.db holds the imported/snapshotted execution state and never replaces this document. Mini Worker is no longer the authoritative plan source.

steps.description: Read the actual current HEAD/working tree and map startup, project creation, DB, workspace, Supervisor, Cline, plan flow. Research/PLAN only; no code changes.
steps.title: HEAD AUDIT

steps.description: Introduce a global category catalog that exists before any project DB. Category selection must not depend on project SQLite.
steps.title: GLOBAL CATEGORY CATALOG

steps.description: Mandatory per-category SPEC.md capability. Every category must carry a human-readable specification document at categories/<category_id>/SPEC.md (the SPEC.md entry named by STEP 2's domain model as SPEC_ENTRY_NAME). SPEC.md is the authoritative category description referenced by STEP 2's global category catalog through REQUIRED_CATEGORY_ENTRIES, and a category must not be ENABLED unless a valid SPEC.md is present. SPEC.md must declare the category's stable identity: the immutable category id slug (^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*) that names the category folder and is never renamed in place, plus the human-readable display name, bound to the id 1:1 (the display name may evolve; the id may not). SPEC.md must declare a version and a deterministic SHA-256 content hash computed over a canonical serialization of the SPEC content. SPEC content validation and the SPEC hash computation are owned by STEP 3: loading must reject a SPEC.md that is missing, malformed, or whose recomputed hash does not equal the declared hash. STEP 5 (PROJECT CREATION FLOW) persists the category identity, version and SPEC hash into project traceability when a project is created after category selection. STEP 7 (PROJECT_STRATEGY.md) derives the project strategy from this category SPEC together with the project task, expected result and project decisions. STEP 3 scope: define the SPEC.md format/schema, the canonical hash computation, the validation rules and the stable-identity/display-name binding; preserve STEP 2's global catalog and never introduce a project-database dependency.
